title.rendered: You’re invited to the future of nDPI: Python, Cybersecurity and Behaviour. May 15th, 4PM CET

content.rendered:
Hi all,
this is to invite you to an open discussion about nDPI, its future. In particular Python bindings, cybersecurity extensions and behaviour analysis. We will meet at 4PM CET (10AM EST) live on the Internet.

For those who have not been able to join, this is the video of the session.

Links:

  • https://github.com/aouinizied/nfstream
  • https://notebooks.gesis.org/binder/jupyter/user/aouinizied-nfstream-tutorials-mg04vt7x/tree

Enjoy!
